config.protocol: one process per (side, cell); warm medians of --reps timed repetitions with torch.cuda.synchronize() around each; idle-device guard per child

structure.route_note: device route: the channels never leave the device (zero-copy DLPack views) and the driver consumes the device fitness tensor, so a generation is one variation graph run with no channel transfer and no fitness readback; the remaining host touch is the evaluator's OUT_NODE guard (a single boolean readback) inside the evaluation lane

fused_device_queued.note: sum of the queued-transfer median and the host-channels fused median

in_graph_queued.note: the in-graph run with a busy queue (pair lane minus the derived queued transfer)

transfer_queued.note: (in-graph run + transfer) pair minus the in-graph run
